page.overview:
Who is Clay?

Clay is the Gym Leader at Driftveil City's Gym. His gym is the fifth gym to be challenged by the trainer. He specializes in using -type Pokémon. He will award the player character the Quake Badge if defeated. A resident of Nimbasa City, Clay's outfit resembles that of a Texan businessman and he has a Texan accent.

Clay is a large man with curly dark brown hair and dark eyes. Clay wears a large cowboy hat, with a yellow stripe and a teal gem on the front. Clay also wears a sleeveless jacket, with small ribbons on his chest, as well as a hazel shirt underneath. He also wears teal pants, with a belt with a yellow buckle, underneath his large brown ones, as well as a pair of dark shoes. Clay is usually seen with his large suitcase and has a watch on his left arm. Clay is of Sinnohan descent, making him equivalent to a Japanese-American.

Although Clay is shown to be impatient and hotheaded, he is good of heart and cares greatly for his hometown, Driftveil City, and for the Unova region as a whole. He is willing to put aside his role of Gym Leader to protect Driftveil from antagonistic people, specifically Team Plasma. Clay pioneered Driftveil's redevelopment between Black & White and Black & White 2 and founded the Pokémon World Tournament to increase the city's popularity.

The name Clay comes from "clay", a type of sticky, fine-grained soil, often used to make pottery, bricks, and ceramics.
